headline: Southwest Wisconsin measles outbreak spread escalates
summary: A measles outbreak in Southwest Wisconsin has grown to 92 confirmed cases and six probable cases, mostly unvaccinated individuals. DHS reports 40% of patients are adults. Transmission occurs primarily within households due to measles' infectious nature. Public health officials emphasize vaccination as prevention. Nationally, over 2,777 measles cases have been reported this year, including two fatalities in Pennsylvania.

headline: WA governor met with state worker protest at hospital construction ceremony
summary: State employees protested near a gubernatorial event commemorating the construction of a new psychiatric facility, expressing frustration over delayed collective bargaining agreement negotiations.

headline: More rural hospital closures would mean long drives for pregnant women seeking obstetric care
summary: The closure of rural hospitals' obstetric units in 14 states could force Medicaid patients to drive over an hour for maternity care, exacerbating maternal health disparities. A KFF study warns that recent healthcare changes may accelerate these closures due to reduced payments and work requirements for Medicaid enrollment.

headline: Prosecutor will take Houston ICE shooting case to grand jury
summary: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo's fatal shooting by an immigration officer in Houston prompts a memorial event.

headline: Civil rights groups make urgent plea for voting rights in DC, ahead of midterm elections
summary: Hundreds gathered at the Lincoln Memorial for the Defend the Vote March on Washington protesting voting rights rollbacks after a Supreme Court decision weakened protections under the Voting Rights Act. Speakers like Sen. Bernie Sanders and Martin Luther King III criticized Republican-led redistricting efforts targeting Black communities. Demonstrators feared further erosion of voting rights, with lawmakers vowing to continue pushing for civil rights.

headline: Minnesota attorney general allows out-of-state acquisition of North Memorial Health
summary: Minnesota's Attorney General approved a 10-year oversight agreement for Sanford Health's acquisition of North Memorial Health, ensuring Robbinsdale hospital's full services and union contracts. This policy decision maintains public health access to critical care facilities and services, particularly benefiting low-income patients.
